name: Mira (fictional)
whatIKnow: I like making places look pretty and real. I know harbors have lighthouses, boats, flags and buoys.
whatIWantToBuild: My island Gullport, but prettier: colors, flowers, flags, a sunset sky, lanterns on the pier, a striped lighthouse, little fish in the water, signs with names.
howIReactToQuestions: I only want to make things look nice. When the builder asks me something, I usually ignore it and send my next look request. If it is a choice about colors I answer it.
howIUseTheApp: I look at the picture and say what to change about how it looks. I almost never press buttons except to see a new color.
style: Short lines, lowercase, lots of 'and'. Says 'so cute' sometimes. Never asks how anything works.
